Nothing heard yet.\nTap Start scan — real devices and networks around you will appear here, closest first.

Tap a result for full detail. Long-press (or Track) to pin a device and get a proximity alert. Distances are estimates from signal strength. ⚠ pattern flags are patterns to look at, never proof of an attack.

Ghost BLE Tracking needs Bluetooth Scan, Nearby Wi-Fi and (on older Android) location permission because Android requires them to return Bluetooth and Wi-Fi scan results at all. The app never reads your GPS location and sends nothing anywhere.
A scan permission was denied, so Android will not return real scan results. You can grant it any time in Settings > Apps > Ghost BLE Tracking > Permissions, then tap Start scan again.

Android throttles Wi-Fi scans (max 4 per 2 minutes for a foreground app), so this Wi-Fi scan was limited — showing the most recent Wi-Fi results Android has. BLE scanning is not throttled and keeps running in real time.
